// Package unformatted holds shapes gofmt would rewrite, which the original still judges: parentheses gofmt folds or
// drops, a semicolon gofmt drops, an empty statement beside the call, and an else that holds one.
package unformatted

func guarded(values map[string]int, key string) {
	if _, ok := ((values[key])); (ok) {
		delete(values, key)
	}
	if _, ok := ((values))[((key))]; ((ok)) {
		((delete))(((values)), ((key)))
	}
	if _, ok := values[key]; ok {
		((delete(values, key)));
	}
	if _, ok := values[key]; ok { delete(values, key) }
	if _, ok := values[key]; ok {
		;
		delete(values, key)
	}
	if _, ok := values[key]; ok {
		delete(values, key);;
	}
	if _, ok := values[key]; ok {
		delete(values, key)
	} else { ; }
	if _, ok := values[key]; ok { delete(values, key) } else {}
}
